verdict.rationale: Orama lets you control where data lives by deploying Orama Cloud's context server on your own infrastructure or running it "in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated" [orama-docs-8, orama-docs-51]. The open-source library can also run entirely in your own app or browser [orama-docs-12, orama-gh-6]. There is no evidence of a region picker or residency guarantees for the managed cloud, so residency control comes mainly through self-hosting. Missing for 10: region selection for managed Orama Cloud, documented data-residency/compliance commitments (e.g., EU/US regions), independent corroboration.
